title: Haze4K train internal-development baseline local-error measurement
rationale: The archived train audit and deterministic split qualification established 750 canonical clear scenes and a candidate-unseen 150-scene internal-development role containing 600 nested haze variants. This route performs no training and uses the fixed official Haze4K ConvIR-B checkpoint only on those 150 scenes. It preregisters under-recovery, signed overshoot, and low-demand harm without assuming a monotonic haze-demand direction. Scene repeatability and scene-level uncertainty decide whether a separate non-deployable keep, weaken, or strengthen oracle is warranted. Official test is absent.

scientific_contract.question: On the 150 canonical Haze4K train internal-development scenes, does fixed official ConvIR-B exhibit a material prevalence of repeatable local under-recovery, signed overshoot, or low-demand harm while remaining globally competent?

intervention.reference: paired hazy input and ground-truth clear image within the frozen internal-development split
intervention.matched_budget: one frozen official ConvIR-B inference for each of 600 nested haze variants, zero training steps
fixed_factors: official ConvIR-B base graph with 8,630,665 frozen parameters and strict checkpoint load
Haze4K train only; official test absent
canonical scene SHA-256 over clear width, height, and decoded RGB bytes
split salt haze4k-local-error-qualification-v2 and assignment digest 7b21d3af455475f7bb29198081a2ef2e651cffaac6149fd27741863c765b4efc
32-by-32 nonoverlapping tiles with bottom-right reflection padding
paired input-versus-GT RGB MSE defines demand; lowest and highest 20 percent tile regions are disjoint
under-recovery requires alpha at most 0.80 and output-to-input tile error ratio at least 0.25 in high-demand tiles
signed overshoot requires alpha at least 1.05 and projected magnitude at least 1/255 over all tiles
low-demand harm requires output-to-input tile error ratio at least 1.10 and MSE increase at least squared 1/255
a construct is variant-material when at least 20 percent of its eligible tiles qualify
a construct is scene-stable when variant-material in at least three of four haze variants
under-recovery, signed overshoot, and low-demand harm are parallel preregistered constructs
high-minus-low demand overshoot contrast is secondary and has no required direction
20,000 scene-level bootstrap resamples with seed 20260723 for continuous paired summaries

primary_estimand.metric: proportion of 150 canonical clear scenes with at least one preregistered construct material in three or four nested haze variants
primary_estimand.aggregation: four variants summarized within scene followed by equal-weight Wilson inference across 150 scenes

controls: exact parent split closeout identity and authorization
exact Haze4K train-only path, 3,000 paired observations, 750 canonical scenes, and frozen assignment digest
synthetic unchanged, exact-GT, partial-recovery, strong-overshoot, and low-demand-harm reference cases
strict official checkpoint load, frozen parameter scope, finite three-scale forward, and finite finalizer
global competence prerequisite based on output MSE below input MSE within clear scene
scene-level aggregation and resampling; tiles and haze variants never count as independent groups

uncertainty.method: two-sided 95 percent Wilson intervals for scene prevalences and paired 20,000-resample bootstrap over canonical clear scenes for continuous contrasts

gates.estimand: parent authorization, frozen split identity, 150 complete scenes, 600 finite variant inferences, no official-test access, and no training
lower 95 percent Wilson bound for scenes whose mean output MSE is below mean input MSE
95 percent Wilson interval for stable-any-material-local-error scene prevalence

scientific_contract.competing_explanation: Apparent local heterogeneity may reflect RGB-MSE/projection construct choice, content and padding geometry, or correlated synthetic variants rather than a haze-specific causal mechanism or a deployable risk signal.
disabled_actions: Haze4K official-test file, target, prediction, or metric access
NH-HAZE, confirmation, canary, or locked-test access
training, fitting, proxy selection, structure selection, or threshold adaptation
claiming paired input error is pure haze density or a deployment-available feature
claiming signed RGB projection alone proves perceptual over-dehazing or causal mechanism
assuming high-demand or low-demand regions must have a monotonic error direction
treating tiles, haze variants, or clear aliases as independent statistical groups
automatically continuing into oracle, proxy, or module execution

precision_contract.rationale: All 150 independent development scenes are used. A worst-case 95 percent prevalence half-width target of 0.081 requires 147 scenes, so the frozen census is feasible; four nested variants do not increase n.

capability.production_path_statement: The exact official Haze4K ConvIR-B base graph is strict-loaded from the fixed official checkpoint, fully frozen, run through its three-scale CUDA forward, and finalized by the exact local measurement and scene aggregation path on a no-data synthetic fixture.

precision.source_reference: Worst-case Bernoulli standard deviation 0.5 fixed analytically before Haze4K outcomes; all 150 canonical development scenes are used and nested variants do not add independent groups.
